name: Opening the login twice in a row reuses the same account
title: SC-12-10-04 Opening the login twice in a row reuses the same account
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the person card "Can Ozturk" with an email
When the Site Manager opens the login twice without removing it
Then exactly one login account exists for the person
And exactly one unused activation link remains
